note: Editor review of two desk updates: attribution, Rennes detail, source names

event.label: reported
event.text: France: about 15,000 people marched in Rennes on October 31 against the cost of living and in support of the school students' movement, Ouest-France reports. Local unions say they will keep their November 5 march route despite a prefectural ban.

event.label: disputed
event.text: France: officials said 48 of the country's 3,700 high schools and 51 of 184 higher-education institutions were disrupted on November 3, while the USL student union put the number of blocked schools at about 500 and the Union Étudiante said over 50 campuses were blockaded. The USL denounced riot police deployed outside schools; Education Minister Édouard Geffray said on X that blockades deprive students of their right to an education. A nationwide union strike is set for November 5.
